name: @lacspace/thumbgen
description: Thumbnail variants for YouTube (1280×720), Open Graph (1200×630), square and story from a headline and an optional licensed photo — split (text + cover-cropped photo), fullbleed with legibility scrim, typographic band, number badge for data stories, and quote layouts; urgency (breaking banner) and category accent colours; headline auto-fit to 3–4 lines with correct Devanagari shaping (sharp/Pango via @lacspace/newscard); credit line, logo; a rationale per variant so an A/B bandit can pick. Deterministic, no AI tokens.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
